issues.diagnosis: In your E60 (E60) you average +100 centipawns out of the opening but lose 50.0% of 4 games; in your E70 (E70) you average +100 centipawns out of the opening but lose 50.0% of 4 games; in your E80 (E80) you average +100 centipawns out of the opening but lose 50.0% of 4 games — the opening isn't the problem, the follow-up is.
issues.prescription: When you come out of the opening fine, switch from memorizing theory to middlegame planning: before every move, ask what your opponent's best reply is — and spend 10 minutes a day on the plans for your worst lines.
